-- Relational evaluation preserves input encounter order through every operator.
import Json (..)
import Model (..)
import Binder (tree_any)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length, sum)

pub fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) =>
      if x == y then
        0
      elif x then
        1
      else
        -1
    _ => 0

fn is_false(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => not(b)
    _ => false

fn is_true(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => b
    _ => false

fn and3(a : Json, b : Json) : Json =
  if is_false(a) || is_false(b) then
    JBool(false)
  elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
    JNull
  else
    JBool(true)

fn or3(a : Json, b : Json) : Json =
  if is_true(a) || is_true(b) then
    JBool(true)
  elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
    JNull
  else
    JBool(false)

fn coalesce_eval(args : List(Expr), row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  match args of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(a, rest) =>
      let v = evaluate(a, row, group)
      if is_null(v) then
        coalesce_eval(rest, row, group)
      else
        v

pub fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif op == "IS_NULL" then
    JBool(is_null(evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)))
  elif op == "IS_NOT_NULL" then
    JBool(not(is_null(evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group))))
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    coalesce_eval(e.args, row, group)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" then
      if length(e.args) == 0 then
        JInt(length(group))
      else
        JInt(
            length(
                filter(
                    \(r) -> not(is_null(evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []))),
                    group,
                  ),
              ),
          )
    else
      let vs = filter(
          \(v) -> not(is_null(v)),
          map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group),
        )
      if op == "SUM" then
        if length(vs) == 0 then
          JNull
        else
          JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "NOT" then
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if is_null(a) then
      JNull
    else
      JBool(not(truth(a)))
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
    if op == "AND" then
      and3(a, b)
    elif op == "OR" then
      or3(a, b)
    elif elem(op, ["+", "-", "*"]) then
      if is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        JNull
      else
        JInt(
            if op == "+" then
              integer(a) + integer(b)
            elif op == "-" then
              integer(a) - integer(b)
            else
              integer(a) * integer(b),
          )
    else
      if is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        JNull
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

fn extremum(vs : List(Json), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, Nil) => v
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      let b = extremum(rest, minimum)
      if (compare_value(v, b) < 0) == minimum then
        v
      else
        b

pub fn fold_constants(e : Expr) : Expr =
  let n = Expr { ..e, args = map(fold_constants, e.args) }
  if (not(agg(n.op))
      && not(elem(n.op, ["lit", "col"]))
      && all(\(a) -> a.op == "lit", n.args)) then
    literal(evaluate(n, [], []))
  else
    n

fn conjuncts(e : Expr) : List(Expr) =
  if e.op == "AND" then
    append(conjuncts(at(e.args, 0)), conjuncts(at(e.args, 1)))
  else
    [e]

fn sources(e : Expr) : List(Int) =
  if e.op == "col" then
    [e.source]
  else
    flatten(map(sources, e.args))

fn combine(es : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  match es of
    Nil => literal(JBool(true))
    Cons(e, Nil) => e
    Cons(e, rest) => Expr { ..node("AND", [e, combine(rest)]), kind = "bool" }

-- Push a conjunct only when every referenced slot belongs to one join input,
-- and only when that input is reached exclusively through inner joins: a
-- right-side filter under a left join must not become a pre-join scan filter,
-- since that would silently turn WHERE-style exclusion into ON-style padding.
pub fn optimize(plan : Plan) : Plan =
  let q = plan.query
  let terms = conjuncts(fold_constants(q.predicate))
  let scan_ok = \(i) -> i == 0 || not(at(q.join_types, i - 1))
  let pushable = \(e) ->
    let ss = sources(e) in
    length(plan.tables) > 1
      && length(ss) > 0
      && all(\(s) -> s == at(ss, 0), ss)
      && scan_ok(at(ss, 0))
  let fs = map(
      \(i) -> filter(\(e) -> pushable(e) && at(sources(e), 0) == i, terms),
      range(0, length(plan.tables)),
    )
  let rem = filter(\(e) -> not(pushable(e)), terms)
  let bq = Query {
    ..q,
    predicate = combine(rem),
    select = map(\(s) -> (fold_constants(fst(s)), snd(s)), q.select),
    joins = map(fold_constants, q.joins),
    having = fold_constants(q.having)
  }
  Plan { ..plan, query = bq, filters = fs }

fn join_rows(
  left : List(List(Json)),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr
) : List(List(Json)) =
  flatten(
      map(
          \(l) -> filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(on, r, [])), map(\(r) -> append(l, r), right)),
          left,
        ),
    )

fn left_join_row(
  l : List(Json),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  right_width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  let matches = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(on, r, [])), map(\(r) -> append(l, r), right))
  if length(matches) > 0 then
    matches
  else
    [append(l, replicate(right_width, JNull))]

fn left_join_rows(
  left : List(List(Json)),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  right_width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  flatten(map(\(l) -> left_join_row(l, right, on, right_width), left))

pub type Group = Group { key: String, rows: List(List(Json)) }

fn add_group(gs : List(Group), key : String, row : List(Json)) : List(Group) =
  match gs of
    Nil => [Group { key = key, rows = [row] }]
    Cons(g, rest) =>
      if g.key == key then
        Cons(Group { ..g, rows = append(g.rows, [row]) }, rest)
      else
        Cons(g, add_group(rest, key, row))

fn groups_for(rows : List(List(Json)), keys : List(Expr)) : List(Group) =
  var gs := []
  for row in sof(rows) do
    let key = encode(JArr(map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), keys)))
    gs := add_group(gs, key, row)
  if length(keys) == 0 && length(rows) == 0 then
    [Group { key = "[]", rows = [] }]
  else
    gs

fn project(
  q : Query,
  row : List(Json),
  group : List(List(Json))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  if truth(evaluate(q.having, row, group)) then
    [map(\(s) -> evaluate(fst(s), row, group), q.select)]
  else
    []

fn distinct_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  seen : List(String)
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) =>
      let key = encode(JArr(r))
      if elem(key, seen) then
        distinct_rows(rest, seen)
      else
        Cons(r, distinct_rows(rest, Cons(key, seen)))

fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, desc, nf), rest) =>
      let va = at(a, i)
      let vb = at(b, i)
      let na = is_null(va)
      let nb = is_null(vb)
      if na && nb then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      elif na then
        if nf then -1 else 1
      elif nb then
        if nf then 1 else -1
      else
        let c = compare_value(va, vb)
        if c == 0 then
          row_compare(a, b, rest)
        elif desc then
          -c
        else
          c

fn insert_row(
  r : List(Json),
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => [r]
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      if row_compare(r, x, order) <= 0 then
        Cons(r, rows)
      else
        Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

fn sort_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) => insert_row(r, sort_rows(rest, order), order)

pub fn execute(plan : Plan) : Json =
  let q = plan.query
  var scans := []
  var offset := 0
  for i in srange(0, length(plan.tables)) do
    let t = at(plan.tables, i)
    let padding = replicate(offset, JNull)
    let predicates = at(plan.filters, i)
    let rs = filter(
        \(r) -> all(\(p) -> truth(evaluate(p, append(padding, r), [])), predicates),
        t.rows,
      )
    scans := append(scans, [rs])
    offset += length(t.columns)
  var rows := at(scans, 0)
  for i in srange(0, length(q.joins)) do
    let right_width = length(at(plan.tables, i + 1).columns)
    rows :=
      if at(q.join_types, i) then
        left_join_rows(rows, at(scans, i + 1), at(q.joins, i), right_width)
      else
        join_rows(rows, at(scans, i + 1), at(q.joins, i))
  let filtered = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(q.predicate, r, [])), rows)
  let projected =
    if plan.aggregate then
      flatten(
          map(
              \(g) -> project(q, if length(g.rows) > 0 then at(g.rows, 0) else [], g.rows),
              groups_for(filtered, q.groups),
            ),
        )
    else
      flatten(map(\(r) -> project(q, r, []), filtered))
  let distinct =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_rows(projected, [])
    else
      projected
  let sorted =
    if length(plan.order) > 0 then
      sort_rows(distinct, plan.order)
    else
      distinct
  let skipped = drop(q.offset, sorted)
  let final =
    if q.limit >= 0 then
      take(q.limit, skipped)
    else
      skipped
  JObj([
      ("columns", JArr(map(\(s) -> JStr(snd(s)), q.select))),
      ("rows", JArr(map(JArr, final))),
    ])

-- Typed syntax and bound logical plan. JSON is used only for wire values.
import Json (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length)

pub effect Domain
  never reject(String) : Unit

pub fn demand(b : Bool, code : String) : Unit =
  if not(b) then
    reject(code)

pub fn arr(j : Json) : List(Json) =
  match j of
    JArr(xs) => xs
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      []

pub fn text(j : Json) : String =
  match j of
    JStr(s) => s
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      ""

pub fn integer(j : Json) : Int =
  match j of
    JInt(n) => n
    _ => 0

pub fn truth(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => b
    _ => false

pub fn is_null(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JNull => true
    _ => false

pub fn getfield(j : Json, key : String) : Json =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) => lookup_field(xs, key)
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull

fn lookup_field(xs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match xs of
    Nil =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull
    Cons((k, v), rest) =>
      if k == key then
        v
      else
        lookup_field(rest, key)

pub fn fields(j : Json, names : List(String)) : Unit =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) =>
      demand(length(xs) == length(names), "INVALID_INPUT")
      demand(
          all(
              \(name) -> length(filter(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == name, xs)) == 1,
              names,
            ),
          "INVALID_INPUT",
        )
    _ => reject("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn reserved(s : String) : Bool =
  elem(
      to_upper(s),
      split(
          32,
          "SELECT DISTINCT AS FROM INNER JOIN LEFT OUTER ON WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC NULLS FIRST LAST LIMIT OFFSET AND OR NOT IS NULL TRUE FALSE COALESCE COUNT SUM MIN MAX",
        ),
    )

pub fn letter(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 97 && c <= 122 || c == 95

pub fn digit(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 48 && c <= 57

pub fn name_ok(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) > 0
    && letter(byte_at(s, 0))
    && all(
        \(i) -> letter(byte_at(s, i)) || digit(byte_at(s, i)),
        range(0, byte_len(s)),
      )
    && not(reserved(s))

pub fn value_type(v : Json) : String =
  match v of
    JInt(_) => "int"
    JBool(_) => "bool"
    JStr(_) => "text"
    _ => "invalid"

pub type Column = Column {
  name: String,
  kind: String,
  qualifier: String,
  source: Int,
  index: Int,
  nullable: Bool
}

pub type Table = Table {
  name: String,
  columns: List(Column),
  rows: List(List(Json))
}

pub type Expr = Expr {
  op: String,
  value: Json,
  qualifier: String,
  name: String,
  args: List(Expr),
  kind: String,
  index: Int,
  source: Int
}

pub fn node(op : String, args : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  Expr {
    op = op,
    value = JNull,
    qualifier = "",
    name = "",
    args = args,
    kind = "",
    index = -1,
    source = -1
  }

fn literal_kind(v : Json) : String =
  match v of
    JNull => "null"
    _ => value_type(v)

pub fn literal(v : Json) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("lit", []), value = v, kind = literal_kind(v) }

pub fn column_ref(q : String, n : String) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("col", []), qualifier = q, name = n }

pub fn agg(op : String) : Bool = elem(op, ["COUNT", "SUM", "MIN", "MAX"])

pub fn at(xs : List(a), i : Int) : a =
  match nth(i, xs) of
    Some(x) => x
    None => at(xs, i)

pub type Query = Query {
  select: List((Expr, String)),
  sources: List((String, String)),
  joins: List(Expr),
  join_types: List(Bool),
  predicate: Expr,
  groups: List(Expr),
  having: Expr,
  has_having: Bool,
  order: List((String, Bool, Bool)),
  distinct: Bool,
  limit: Int,
  offset: Int
}

pub type Plan = Plan {
  query: Query,
  tables: List(Table),
  filters: List(List(Expr)),
  aggregate: Bool,
  order: List((Int, Bool, Bool))
}

fn value_ok(v : Json, c : Column) : Bool =
  match v of
    JNull => c.nullable
    _ => value_type(v) == c.kind

pub fn validate_table(j : Json) : Table =
  fields(j, ["name", "columns", "rows"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  demand(name_ok(n), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let cs = map(validate_column, arr(getfield(j, "columns")))
  demand(length(cs) > 0, "INVALID_INPUT")
  demand(unique(map(\(c) -> c.name, cs)), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let rows = map(arr, arr(getfield(j, "rows")))
  for row in sof(rows) do
    demand(length(row) == length(cs), "INVALID_INPUT")
    for i in srange(0, length(cs)) do
      demand(value_ok(at(row, i), at(cs, i)), "INVALID_INPUT")
  Table { name = n, columns = cs, rows = rows }

fn validate_column(j : Json) : Column =
  fields(j, ["name", "type", "nullable"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  let t = text(getfield(j, "type"))
  demand(name_ok(n) && elem(t, ["int", "text", "bool"]), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let nullable =
    match getfield(j, "nullable") of
      JBool(b) => b
      _ =>
        reject("INVALID_INPUT")
        false
  Column {
    name = n,
    kind = t,
    qualifier = "",
    source = 0,
    index = 0,
    nullable = nullable
  }

pub fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

pub fn elem(x : a, xs : List(a)) : Bool given Eq(a) =
  match xs of
    Nil => false
    Cons(y, rest) => x == y || elem(x, rest)

defs.name: type_ok
defs.source: fn type_ok(a : String, b : String) : Bool = a == "null" || b == "null" || a == b

defs.name: merge_type
defs.source: fn merge_type(a : String, b : String) : String = if a == "null" then b else a

defs.name: coalesce_type
defs.source:
fn coalesce_type(ts : List(String)) : String =
  match ts of
    Nil => "null"
    Cons(t, rest) =>
      let r = coalesce_type(rest)
      demand(type_ok(t, r), "TYPE_ERROR")
      merge_type(t, r)

defs.name: check
defs.source:
fn check(e : Expr, columns : List(Column), allow : Bool, inside : Bool) : Expr =
  if e.op == "col" then
    let matches = filter(
        \(c) -> c.name == e.name && (e.qualifier == "" || e.qualifier == c.qualifier),
        columns,
      )
    demand(length(matches) > 0, "UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
    demand(length(matches) == 1, "AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN")
    let c = at(matches, 0)
    Expr { ..e, index = c.index, source = c.source, kind = c.kind }
  elif e.op == "lit" then
    e
  else
    let isagg = agg(e.op)
    demand(not(isagg) || allow && not(inside), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    let args = map(\(a) -> check(a, columns, allow, inside || isagg), e.args)
    let ts = map(\(a) -> a.kind, args)
    let kind =
      if e.op == "COUNT" then
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["SUM", "+", "-", "*"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> t == "int" || t == "null", ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["MIN", "MAX"]) then
        demand(elem(at(ts, 0), ["int", "text", "null"]), "TYPE_ERROR")
        at(ts, 0)
      elif elem(e.op, ["NOT", "AND", "OR"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> t == "bool" || t == "null", ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "bool"
      elif elem(e.op, ["IS_NULL", "IS_NOT_NULL"]) then
        "bool"
      elif e.op == "COALESCE" then
        coalesce_type(ts)
      else
        demand(type_ok(at(ts, 0), at(ts, 1)), "TYPE_ERROR")
        let merged = merge_type(at(ts, 0), at(ts, 1))
        demand(merged /= "bool" || elem(e.op, ["=", "<>"]), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "bool"
    Expr { ..e, args = args, kind = kind }

defs.name: predicate
tree_any
defs.source:
fn tree_any(p : (Expr) -> Bool, e : Expr) : Bool =
  p(e) || any(\(a) -> tree_any(p, a), e.args)

defs.name: grouped
defs.source:
fn grouped(e : Expr, keys : List(Int)) : Unit =
  if not(agg(e.op)) then
    demand(e.op /= "col" || elem(e.index, keys), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    for a in sof(e.args) do
      grouped(a, keys)

defs.name: find_table
bind
alias_index
defs.source:
fn alias_index(names : List(String), n : String, i : Int) : Int =
  match names of
    Nil =>
      reject("UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
      -1
    Cons(a, rest) =>
      if a == n then
        i
      else
        alias_index(rest, n, i + 1)

defs.name: compare_value
defs.source:
fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) =>
      if x == y then
        0
      elif x then
        1
      else
        -1
    _ => 0

defs.name: is_false
defs.source:
fn is_false(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => not(b)
    _ => false

defs.name: is_true
defs.source:
fn is_true(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => b
    _ => false

defs.name: and3
defs.source:
fn and3(a : Json, b : Json) : Json =
  if is_false(a) || is_false(b) then
    JBool(false)
  elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
    JNull
  else
    JBool(true)

defs.name: or3
defs.source:
fn or3(a : Json, b : Json) : Json =
  if is_true(a) || is_true(b) then
    JBool(true)
  elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
    JNull
  else
    JBool(false)

defs.name: coalesce_eval
defs.source:
fn coalesce_eval(args : List(Expr), row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  match args of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(a, rest) =>
      let v = evaluate(a, row, group)
      if is_null(v) then
        coalesce_eval(rest, row, group)
      else
        v

defs.name: evaluate
defs.source:
fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif op == "IS_NULL" then
    JBool(is_null(evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)))
  elif op == "IS_NOT_NULL" then
    JBool(not(is_null(evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group))))
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    coalesce_eval(e.args, row, group)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" then
      if length(e.args) == 0 then
        JInt(length(group))
      else
        JInt(
            length(
                filter(
                    \(r) -> not(is_null(evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []))),
                    group,
                  ),
              ),
          )
    else
      let vs = filter(
          \(v) -> not(is_null(v)),
          map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group),
        )
      if op == "SUM" then
        if length(vs) == 0 then
          JNull
        else
          JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "NOT" then
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if is_null(a) then
      JNull
    else
      JBool(not(truth(a)))
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
    if op == "AND" then
      and3(a, b)
    elif op == "OR" then
      or3(a, b)
    elif elem(op, ["+", "-", "*"]) then
      if is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        JNull
      else
        JInt(
            if op == "+" then
              integer(a) + integer(b)
            elif op == "-" then
              integer(a) - integer(b)
            else
              integer(a) * integer(b),
          )
    else
      if is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        JNull
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

fn add_group(gs : List(Group), key : String, row : List(Json)) : List(Group) =
  match gs of
    Nil => [Group { key = key, rows = [row] }]
    Cons(g, rest) =>
      if g.key == key then
        Cons(Group { ..g, rows = append(g.rows, [row]) }, rest)
      else
        Cons(g, add_group(rest, key, row))

fn groups_for(rows : List(List(Json)), keys : List(Expr)) : List(Group) =
  var gs := []
  for row in sof(rows) do
    let key = encode(JArr(map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), keys)))
    gs := add_group(gs, key, row)
  if length(keys) == 0 && length(rows) == 0 then
    [Group { key = "[]", rows = [] }]
  else
    gs

defs.name: row_compare
defs.source:
fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, desc, nf), rest) =>
      let va = at(a, i)
      let vb = at(b, i)
      let na = is_null(va)
      let nb = is_null(vb)
      if na && nb then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      elif na then
        if nf then -1 else 1
      elif nb then
        if nf then 1 else -1
      else
        let c = compare_value(va, vb)
        if c == 0 then
          row_compare(a, b, rest)
        elif desc then
          -c
        else
          c

  r : List(Json),
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => [r]
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      if row_compare(r, x, order) <= 0 then
        Cons(r, rows)
      else
        Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) => insert_row(r, sort_rows(rest, order), order)

fn scan_string(s : String, i : Int, acc : String) : (String, Int) =
  demand(i < byte_len(s), "PARSE_ERROR")
  if byte_at(s, i) == 39 then
    if i + 1 < byte_len(s) && byte_at(s, i + 1) == 39 then
      scan_string(s, i + 2, concat(acc, "'"))
    else
      (acc, i + 1)
  else
    scan_string(s, i + 1, concat(acc, str_of_char(chr(byte_at(s, i)))))

  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    i
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if (digit(c) || not(numbers) && (letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90)) then
      scan_word(s, i + 1, numbers)
    else
      i

defs.name: lex
defs.source:
fn lex(s : String, i : Int) : List(Token) =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    [tok("$END")]
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if elem(c, [32, 9, 10, 13]) then
      lex(s, i + 1)
    elif c == 39 then
      let (v, j) = scan_string(s, i + 1, "")
      Cons(Token { word = "LITERAL", value = JStr(v) }, lex(s, j))
    elif digit(c) then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, true)
      let n =
        match parse_int(slice(s, i, j)) of
          Some(v) => v
          None => 0
      Cons(Token { word = "NUMBER", value = JInt(n) }, lex(s, j))
    elif letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90 then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, false)
      let w = slice(s, i, j)
      Cons(tok(if reserved(w) then to_upper(w) else w), lex(s, j))
    else
      let two = slice(s, i, min(i + 2, byte_len(s)))
      if elem(two, ["<>", "<=", ">="]) then
        Cons(tok(two), lex(s, i + 2))
      else
        demand(
            elem(c, [40, 41, 44, 46, 59, 43, 45, 42, 61, 60, 62]),
            "PARSE_ERROR",
          )
        Cons(tok(str_of_char(chr(c))), lex(s, i + 1))

  elif op == "AND" then

defs.name: coalesce_args

defs.source:
fn expression(minimum : Int) : Expr =
  let t = pop()
  let w = t.word
  let e =
    if w == "NOT" then
      node(w, [expression(3)])
    elif w == "(" then
      let x = expression(1)
      expect(")")
      x
    elif w == "-" then
      literal(JInt(-natural()))
    elif elem(w, ["NUMBER", "LITERAL"]) then
      literal(t.value)
    elif elem(w, ["TRUE", "FALSE"]) then
      literal(JBool(w == "TRUE"))
    elif w == "NULL" then
      literal(JNull)
    elif w == "COALESCE" then
      expect("(")
      let args = coalesce_args()
      expect(")")
      demand(length(args) >= 2, "PARSE_ERROR")
      node("COALESCE", args)
    elif agg(w) then
      expect("(")
      let args =
        if w == "COUNT" && accept("*") then
          []
        else
          [expression(1)]
      expect(")")
      node(w, args)
    else
      demand(name_ok(w), "PARSE_ERROR")
      if accept(".") then
        column_ref(w, name())
      else
        column_ref("", w)
  binary(e, minimum, false)

defs.name: query
defs.source:
fn query() : Query =
  expect("SELECT")
  let distinct = accept("DISTINCT")
  let sels = selections()
  expect("FROM")
  let (ss, js, jt) = join_sources([source()], [], [])
  let pred =
    if accept("WHERE") then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let groups =
    if accept("GROUP") then
      expect("BY")
      group_keys()
    else
      []
  let hh = accept("HAVING")
  let hav =
    if hh then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let order =
    if accept("ORDER") then
      expect("BY")
      order_keys()
    else
      []
  let lim =
    if accept("LIMIT") then
      natural()
    else
      -1
  let off =
    if lim >= 0 && accept("OFFSET") then
      natural()
    else
      0
  let ignored = accept(";")
  demand(peek() == "$END", "PARSE_ERROR")
  Query {
    select = sels,
    sources = ss,
    joins = js,
    join_types = jt,
    predicate = pred,
    groups = groups,
    having = hav,
    has_having = hh,
    order = order,
    distinct = distinct,
    limit = lim,
    offset = off
  }
